name: Sister Hale Ambrey
silhouette: Grey robe with a blue hem, lamp on a chain, hands always busy with cloth or cup.
speech_rhythm: Gentle, sideways, blesses rather than answers. Never says 'no'.
vocabulary: we do not ask the water
public_motivation: Bless vessels, keep the Lamp Vigil, feed the poor at the gate.
private_motivation: Protect the founding charter; the gift is still a gift.
contradiction: The kindest person on the summit keeps the cruelest secret out of kindness.
secret: The undercroft holds Marrow's letters and the founding donation record.
